svg.text: Header colour of each class shows the pattern group it belongs to.

g.text: thin dispatch, no own state · 10 CmdAction -> domain calls
- createMachine(def, mode): Machine* ◀ only type switch
+ applyConfig(cfg), reset(), tick(), snapshot(), restore(), setScenario(s)
handle(ev): subscribes to (Fault/Resume, downstreamId) -> fault cascade
Adding a machine type = new subclass + one Factory.createMachine case.

svg.text: ◆ each concrete state is a singleton (static instance()).
Context holds currentState_ and calls transitionTo(next, tick)
-> onExit / onEnter. No state enum in Types.h.
each override update()/name(); Processing & Broken also onEnter().

g.text: raw data only; states derived on restore. MementoStore ◆ this.
CmdAction: None, Start, Pause, Reset, SetSpeed, SetScenario, ForceBreak, InstantRepair, Rewind, ClearLog
MachineType(11): WoodSpawner, BridgeSpawner, PickupSpawner, Head/Neck/BodyCutter, Painter,
EventType(8): Fault, Resume, Started, Completed, Spawned, Packaged, Drop, Backpressure
OverflowMode: Drop, Backpressure ScenarioType(5): Normal, Breakdowns, Bottleneck, Overflow, SmartFactory
ProductType(9): RawWood, HeadPart, NeckPart, BodyPart, Bridge, Pickup, ElecPartSet, AssembledBody, FinishedGuitar
MementoStore ◆ deque<FactorySnap> · Factory.snapshot()/restore() produce & consume FactorySnap (Memento pattern).
Main loop holds base pointers, calls update(tick) / process(tick) with no concrete-type branching.
IMachineState -> 3 states ; ITechnicianState -> 2 states ; contexts: Machine, Technician
Per-state behaviour delegated; transitionTo(next). Concrete states are singletons.
EventBroker + IEventHandler <- EventLog, Statistics, Machine, RepairDispatcher
publish() queues, flush() dispatches by (type) and (type, sourceId). Decouples producers from consumers.
Single type switch builds objects. New machine type = new subclass + one switch case.
push() each tick, rewind(tick) restores prior state incl. RNG state + product id counter.
Factory ◆ Machine / Conveyor / Technician ; Machine ◆ Product ; Conveyor ◆ Product
Strict unique_ptr ownership chain: spawner -> conveyor -> machine -> sink.
Controller -> Factory / Runner / Memento / Loader ; RepairDispatcher -> IMachineLookup, Technician
Controller is a thin dispatcher. Factory implements IMachineLookup so the dispatcher resolves ids without owning.
